name: Donut Chart
description: A framework-free Web Component that reads an HTML table and draws it as a ring, with the total in the hole and the numbers in the legend. Six wedges at most, because past that a ring stops answering the question it was drawn for.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A ring read from a legend, with the total in the hole and a wedge's own figures when it is read.

variants.name: Versus
variants.description: The same five close values as a ring and as bars, so the moment to switch is visible rather than argued.

variants.name: Folding
variants.description: Eleven rows into six wedges, a remainder that is not a category, and the value columns that are not plotted.

variants.name: Interaction
variants.description: Reading a wedge with a pointer or a keyboard, and a legend that never repaints the survivors.

variants.name: Table
variants.description: The data contract, and why a ring needs its table more than a bar chart does.

variants.name: States
variants.description: One slice, a total of zero, refetching, a failure, and values that cannot be part of a whole.
